mapper.select: SELECT p.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) AS reportedQty FROM mes_execution_path_node p LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=p.execution_id AND r.routing_node_id=p.routing_node_id WHERE p.execution_id=#{executionId} GROUP BY p.routing_node_id

SELECT r.id AS reportId,r.quantity_delta+COALESCE(SUM(a.quantity_delta),0) AS effectiveQty FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=e.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_report a ON a.reference_report_id=r.id AND a.execution_id=e.id AND a.routing_node_id=r.routing_node_id WHERE e.id=#{executionId} AND r.id=#{reportId} GROUP BY r.id,r.quantity_delta

SELECT e.id AS executionId,e.workorder_id AS workorderId,e.execution_no AS executionNo,e.routing_id AS routingId, e.target_qty AS targetQty,p.path_status AS pathStatus,COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_delta),0) AS lastNodeReportedQty FROM mes_production_execution e LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path p ON p.id=e.id LEFT JOIN mes_execution_path_node n ON n.execution_id=e.id AND n.sequence_no=(SELECT MAX(last.sequence_no) FROM mes_execution_path_node last WHERE last.execution_id=e.id) LEFT JOIN mes_production_report r ON r.execution_id=e.id AND r.routing_node_id=n.routing_node_id WHERE e.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY e.id,e.workorder_id,e.execution_no,e.routing_id,e.target_qty,p.path_status ORDER BY e.id DESC
